description: Northern Provincial Council - Northern Province Provincial Council Northern Province Supplementary Provision Appropriation Statute No. 06 2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a provincial statute (Northern Province Supplementary Provision For Appropriation Statute No. 06 of 2016) that authorizes supplementary budgetary allocations and financial provisions for the Northern Provincial Council. It establishes legal authority for expenditure reallocations and financial procedures, which falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and financial regulations.
